policies.declarationIntro: Umetia saini kidijitali kila sera hapo juu. Sasa thibitisha kwamba unaelewa na unakubali kuzifuata kwa ujumla.
policies.declarationTextEN: I confirm that I have read, understood, and agree to abide by all Silverleaf Academy staff policies and procedures presented in this section, including the Staff Handbook, HR policies, safeguarding requirements, and operational compliance standards. I understand that these policies govern my conduct and responsibilities as a member of the Silverleaf team, and that I am expected to follow them in my day-to-day work.
policies.declarationTextSW: Ninathibitisha kwamba nimesoma, nimeelewa, na ninakubali kuzingatia sera na taratibu zote za wafanyakazi za Silverleaf Academy zilizowasilishwa katika sehemu hii, ikiwemo Mwongozo wa Wafanyakazi, sera za HR, mahitaji ya ulinzi wa watoto, na viwango vya utii wa uendeshaji. Ninaelewa kwamba sera hizi zinatawala tabia na majukumu yangu kama mwanachama wa timu ya Silverleaf, na kwamba inatarajiwa nizizingatie katika kazi yangu ya kila siku.
policies.checkboxLabel: Nimesoma na kuelewa tamko hapo juu, na ninakubali kuzingatia sera zote katika sehemu hii.
policies.errorIncomplete: Tafadhali tia saini kidijitali kila sera hapo juu kabla ya tamko la mwisho.
policies.errorGeneric: Kuna tatizo limetokea. Tafadhali jaribu tena.
